title: Multi-Step Underwater Acoustic Channel Prediction via Dual-Domain Structure Preservation and Pretrained Transformer
abstract: arXiv:2611.14592v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Accurate future channel state information (CSI) is essential for underwater acoustic (UWA) communication because delays associated with signal propagation, feedback, scheduling, and transceiver reconfiguration can render currently available CSI outdated. However, most existing predictors estimate only the next channel state and obtain multi-step forecasts through recursive rollout, which causes prediction errors to accumulate as the multipath structure evolves. The scarcity of sea-trial measurements further limits reliable model training. To address these challenges, we propose LLM4UACP, a dual-domain, structure-preserving framework that adapts a pretrained Transformer for few-shot multi-step UWA channel prediction. LLM4UACP extracts complementary features from the channel impulse response (CIR) and channel frequency response (CFR), aligns them through Fourier-consistent fusion, and encodes the fused representation as delay-time tokens

translated_title: 基于双域结构保持与预训练Transformer的多步水声信道预测
translated_abstract: 准确的未来信道状态信息（CSI）对水声（UWA）通信至关重要，因为信号传播、反馈、调度和收发机重构所产生的延迟会使当前可用的CSI过时。然而，现有的大多数预测器仅估计下一个信道状态，并通过递归滚动来获得多步预测，这导致随着多径结构的演化，预测误差不断累积。海上实测数据的稀缺进一步限制了可靠模型的训练。为应对这些挑战，我们提出了LLM4UACP，一个双域、结构保持的框架，它将预训练的Transformer适配用于少样本多步水声信道预测。LLM4UACP从信道冲激响应（CIR）和信道频率响应（CFR）中提取互补特征，通过傅里叶一致融合对其进行对齐，并将融合后的表示编码为延迟-时间标记
tldr: 提出LLM4UACP框架，通过融合CIR与CFR双域互补特征的结构保持方法，将预训练Transformer适配于少样本多步水声信道预测，避免了递归预测中误差累积的问题
en_tdlr: Proposes LLM4UACP, a dual-domain structure-preserving framework that adapts a pretrained Transformer for few-shot multi-step underwater acoustic channel prediction, avoiding error accumulation caused by recursive rollout
